participation.context: Refused a sum and a count, and kept the two titles apart from any price.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Reported the watchmen without counting them, and the Rose as a title with no receipt.
participation.name: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope

relations.from: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope

story.body: You heard the yard and the Rose compared, with no sum on either. You went toward home without a count of the watchmen.

relations.from: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope

title: Heard the Rose was thinner and the bill was Antony and Valia
